walk.notes: correctness-1..4/6..10 target the presentation-profile mechanism, config-server UI, and nightly enforcement gate — all outside skills/ (internal/server, cmd/). correctness-5 (all user-visible smine prose in profile language, plain-language glossary) is implemented within my chunk: smine-batch, smine-consolidate, smine-context, smine-memory, smine-permissions, smine-routines, smine-skills, and smine-style each carry a Language/Casual-presentation section honoring this — PASS, no finding.

correctness-11..16/18..20 are config-server/non-developer UX items outside skills/. correctness-17 (nightly keeps content German/jargon-free over time) is covered within my chunk by smine-consolidate's casual jargon sweep and smine-orchestrate's casual-audience judge gate — PASS.

correctness-21..25/27..29 are Go/shell mechanism and config-server template items outside skills/. correctness-26 (threading language into the /smine-consolidate invocation) is a nightly-wrapper call-site concern (cmd/bootstrap or routines/, not in my chunk) — smine-consolidate.md itself documents the language arg correctly but I cannot verify the wrapper actually passes it; flagged as a cross-chunk item for the station, not a finding here.

correctness-30 (every content-producing skill gets a language contract): verified across smine-batch + all five dimension skills (context/memory/permissions/routines/skills) — PASS. correctness-31 (canonical group titles stay verbatim, machine-read): smine-skills and smine-permissions both explicitly flag their group titles as verbatim machine-read keys — PASS. correctness-32 (consolidate's sweep widened to every mutable prose field): smine-consolidate's language arg description lists exactly that field set — PASS. correctness-33/34 are config-server render-path items outside skills/. correctness-35 (one-time or nightly consolidate language run) and correctness-36 (smine-batch authors batch JSON prose in profile language, .md stays English) are both satisfied by smine-consolidate.md and smine-batch.md respectively — PASS.

correctness-37..39/41/42/44 are shell-wrapper (cmd/bootstrap, cmd/sync) and config-server UI items outside skills/. correctness-40 requires smine-orchestrate to be 'gated on the audience being non-developer (env override wins), defaulting off on developer machines' — smine-orchestrate's own SKILL.md documents no such audience gate (it describes itself as judging any nightly run unconditionally); the gate, if it exists, lives in the invoking wrapper script which is outside my chunk — flagged as a cross-chunk item for the station, not a finding here since I cannot read the wrapper. correctness-43 (orchestrator granted Edit/Write) — smine-orchestrate's allowed-tools frontmatter includes Read/Write/Edit and its own text explicitly refuses to write settings.json directly (duty excludes that write) — consistent, PASS.

correctness-45..53 (acdsl/policy.json self-management modes, verifier allowlist, gate authority, branch-topology privilege boundary) are Go code under cmd/acdsl, internal/, not present in my chunk. smine-apply.md references the generation/policy mechanism consistently with no contradiction observed, but the policy implementation itself is cross-chunk — no finding.

correctness-54 FAILS in principle (v8.4 reverses the --no-context suppression the spec requires, confirmed via changelog.json v8.3→v8.4 and railroad-review.js's bare lanePrompt()), but this exact defect is already carried as known entry correctness-BLK-6-r1 (fix_state open) — not re-reported per the known-ledger rule. correctness-55 (branches moved to claude-review/* namespace) is satisfied — verified in both SKILL.md v8.3 changelog and railroad-review.js's laneBranchName/refuterBranches/station branch naming and cleanup enumeration, all claude-review/* — PASS. correctness-56 (trace runbook of jq recipes) and correctness-57 (future peek-mcp verbose-mode contract, explicitly 'not implemented' per its own wording) and correctness-58/59 (context-entry eviction observational-only, benchmark harness deferred) are docs/runbook or context-rule material, not present as skills/ files in my chunk — no finding.

correctness-60 (Welcome Bootstrap card date picker) and correctness-64..66 (sessions UI archive tab, reload button removal, repo-add Name field) are config-server UI, outside skills/. correctness-61 (casual rename everywhere) and correctness-62 (casual lockout: never propose/apply edits to a non-user-owned skill, enforced at extraction/apply/orchestrate-judge) and correctness-63 (session partitioning per repo, retiring --scopes) are directly checkable in my chunk: 'casual' terminology is used consistently (not 'non-developer') across smine-apply/smine-skills/smine-context/smine-memory/smine-routines/smine-permissions/smine-orchestrate — PASS. The casual-lockout three-point enforcement (extraction/apply/orchestrate-judge) is present verbatim in smine-skills (extraction), smine-apply (apply), and smine-orchestrate (judge) — PASS. smine-batch/smine-context/smine-memory/smine-routines/smine-skills/smine-permissions all describe per-repo folder routing (sessions/<name>/) replacing the old --scopes personal/work split — PASS. One partial gap: correctness-62 says the origin: user stamp is 'applied by smine-apply/skillroutine-create at skill creation' — skillroutine-create.md only documents stamping origin: user when the skill is 'created from a proposal ... or driven by an accepted proposals/skills.json entry'; a direct, non-proposal-driven /skillroutine-create invocation (a casual user asking the agent to author a skill ad hoc) is not documented as getting the stamp. This is plausible but speculative (I cannot prove this path is exercised in practice, and the primary casual-skill-creation path IS the proposal flow, which is correctly stamped) — I withhold it as a standalone finding given the low confidence and rare exposure; noted for the station's awareness.

correctness-67 (/smine-bootstrap skill deleted): confirmed absent from my file list and from smine-style/smine-orchestrate's Workflow-position wording ('bootstrap wrapper', not a skill) — PASS. correctness-68 (wrapper script becomes the single bootstrap mechanism) and correctness-69 (parameters travel as wrapper env vars) are cmd/bootstrap/run.sh shell-script concerns, outside skills/ — no finding, consistent with what my chunk's skills reference. correctness-70 (smine-batch default-deny self-mining exclusion) verified verbatim in smine-batch.md's Select step — PASS. correctness-71 (Dev Mode profile boolean controlling --dev) is a profile-page/wrapper concern outside skills/. correctness-72 (bootstrap stages grant --add-dir) is wrapper-level; smine-style.md's own text references it consistently ('the bootstrap wrapper grants the directory via --add-dir') — no contradiction, but unverifiable from skills/ alone. correctness-73 (style-mining writes directives in profile language) verified in smine-style.md step 4 — PASS. correctness-74 (casual-install prose scrubbed of paths/IDs/jargon, enforced at authoring/consolidate/orchestrate-judge) verified across smine-context, smine-memory, smine-routines, smine-skills, smine-permissions (authoring), smine-consolidate (sweep), smine-orchestrate (judge gate) — PASS. correctness-75 (earlier stages best-effort, orchestrate-bootstrap is the terminal judge) is wrapper-script control flow outside skills/ — no finding.

correctness-76..82 (plan-format anchor removal, F/D/section-slug links, section reorder, UI-evidence screenshot requirement, context.json regeneration) are context/rules/plan.md and cmd/rules concerns, not present as skills/ files in my chunk except as consumers: fdesign/SKILL.md's plan template (Open questions after Decisions, plain-text F/D ids with section-slug links, Hot items requiring actual-UI screenshots under plans/{slug}/design/ui/) matches every one of these requirements verbatim, and fdesign's changelog documents exactly this migration (v3.6) — PASS, no finding.

correctness-83..89 (worktree-status merge-tree containment layer, cache versioning, cache invalidation on remove, repos-index Worktrees column, routine run-history grouping, page layout reorder, dead single-branch route) are all internal/server Go/template code, not present in my chunk (skills/) — no finding.

correctness-90 (smine-style mines user messages into a ≤30-line style profile, no verbatim quoting/PII/profanity) verified in smine-style.md Steps 2-4 and Hard invariants — PASS. correctness-91 (style profile and presentation profile stay separate files) — PASS, smine-style only ever writes style-profile.md. correctness-92 (style mining is a stage of bootstrap, after reading declared profile, before mining; never contradicts declared audience/language) — smine-style.md Workflow position says 'install → bootstrap wrapper (Style stage) → nightly takes over', consistent with the later spec-9 supersession that replaced the /smine-bootstrap skill with the wrapper script (spec feedback supersedes the original 'stage of /smine-bootstrap' wording) — not a conflict, PASS under the superseding spec. correctness-93..96 (config-server Profile page, live mutex-guarded profile store, skill-sync re-run on audience flip, Profile page visible in both audiences) are config-server Go/template concerns, not present in my chunk — no finding.

correctness-97..104 (per-profile peek-mcp ports, install.env, configserver healthz identity check, stale-listener kill, control-port binding, OTLP endpoint templating) are all cmd/configserver, cmd/peek-mcp(external), and install-script concerns — none of this is implemented in skills/ files; smine-batch/smine-style merely consume peek-mcp as a tool dependency with no port-handling logic of their own — no finding, correctly out of my chunk.

correctness-105..112 (repos.json read-through cache, Add/Remove re-read-under-lock, failed-reload fallback, worktree-status fingerprint invalidation, dead endpoint removal) are internal/server Go code, not present in skills/ — no finding.

notes: Two defects I independently found while walking this chunk were already present in the known-findings ledger and are not re-reported here: (1) session-mine.js's Trim stage (~line 176) enumerates only proposals/{routines,context,skills}.json despite smine-permissions being wired into PROPOSAL_DIMENSIONS in this same diff, so --max-proposals-mined never counts/trims permissions proposals — matches known correctness-MAJ-7-r1, fix_state open. (2) railroad-review's v8.4 changelog entry reverses the v8.3 --no-context lane-injection suppression that spec-7's correctness-54 requires, so lanes again receive the full dispatcher doctrine injection — matches known correctness-BLK-6-r1, fix_state open. Cross-chunk items flagged in the walk for the station's awareness (unverifiable from skills/ alone): correctness-26 (whether the nightly wrapper actually passes --language to /smine-consolidate) and correctness-40 (whether smine-orchestrate's invocation is actually gated on non-developer audience) both depend on wrapper shell scripts outside this chunk.
